name: Python 3
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade -y && sudo xargs apt install -y <packages.txt; [ -f pyproject.toml ] && curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh && uv sync --frozen; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'

postAttachCommand.server: uv run streamlit run main.py --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false
